title: The clarinet falls apart during his solo
summary: During a featured clarinet solo the cracked lower half of the horn dropped on the floor.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: And I'd like to tell you a little funny thing that happened to me. I was going to be featured on clarinet on a number in the show. I had to come out to the front of the microphone, and play this solo spot. And oh, the place was just full of people all around the ringside, and... Back in those days people really dressed. They'd really come out to put it on, you know. Boy, everything was just beautiful. And I had a crack in the bottom half of the clarinet. So by the time I got started in my solo good, the bottom half of the clarinet fell on the floor! [LAUGHS HEARTILY] And it cracked everybody up. The band just couldn't play, boy. Oh, that was a real cliff-hanger. [LAUGHS]
Oh, you could have bought me for a penny-and-a-half! [LAUGHS]
